observations: Photo shows a single PS4-style console, wrapped in plastic, held up by a hand against a marble-pattern background.
Console appears to be an original/'fat' PS4 shape (two-tone cream top, black bottom) but no model plate or serial number is readable.
A small yellow sticker is visible on the console but its text is illegible.
No controller, cables, power cord, or games are visible in the photo.
Watermark 'SHOW GAMES' overlays the image, seller-added branding, not proof of contents.

Pricing claim, not a physical attribute visible in any photo.
Photo 0 shows only the bare console wrapped in plastic; no controller, power cable, HDMI cable, or box of accessories is visible.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal fault (common issue with used PS4 units, e.g. HDMI port, disc drive, overheating)
risks.proof: A clip showing the console powered on, displaying the home screen, and a game loading from disc or hard drive

risks.risk: Claimed accessories (controller, cables) may not actually be included
risks.proof: A photo showing controller, power cable, HDMI cable, and any other accessories laid out next to the console
risks.if_unproven: priced as console only, no accessories

risks.risk: Claimed 7 games may not exist or may be unlicensed/corrupted copies
risks.proof: A photo or screen recording of the games library/menu showing 7 distinct game titles

risks.risk: Console could be a counterfeit, refurbished shell, or have swapped internals
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rear model/serial plate and a power-on test
risks.if_unproven: priced at worst case as unverified/used condition

risks.risk: Cosmetic damage or missing parts hidden under plastic wrap
risks.proof: Unwrapped photos from multiple angles including ports and vents
risks.if_unproven: priced as used with unknown cosmetic condition

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and loading a game, showing the home screen clearly
Photo of all included accessories (controller, power cable, HDMI cable) laid out beside the console
Photo/video of the games library showing the 7 claimed games
Clear photo of the rear model/serial plate, unwrapped
Photos of the console from multiple angles without plastic wrap
response.reason: The item is identifiable only by type (PS4 console) with no model plate readable and no proof of claimed accessories, games, or working condition, so it must be priced at worst case as a bare, unverified-working used console with no accessories or games included.
